segments.source: Overview
segments.normalizedSource: Overview
segments.contextBefore: Use the scoped identifiers that GameKit provides you as player IDs when transmitting or saving player data.
segments.contextAfter: If you store player data outside of Game Center, use the scoped player identifiers that GameKit provides for you to identify the local player’s data — not their name and avatar, which may change, or other personal information that’s private.
